art_direction: At a light-filled everyday desk, a fictional adult looks amused and relieved while holding a working deep green smartphone with a simple bright abstract screen. A separate silver smartphone rests nearby with its screen dark and unresponsive, conveying a device problem without sparks, smoke, fire or hazardous battery damage. Include a cup and book, no readable covers. Clear silhouettes, believable hands, relaxed body language, gentle morning color and a pale calm lower area. No text or branding.
